name: light_spear_impact
for: angel_priest lance of light / the_archangel spear of light, hit
notes: One-shot at the hit point (= the spear tip): the spearhead drives in (frames 1-2), a hard white-gold 8-point star with long rays, then the spear shatters into gold light slivers flung back along its line and cooling to amber, a few spark streaks, motes blinking out. Light: nothing falls or settles. Priest scale; archangel x0.86 or as is.
